title: Market Radar Events Feed
description: Industry hot news, price cuts, new releases, and policy deals for LLM APIs.

events.title: Gemma 3 27B (-64%), GPT-OSS 120B ($0.05) & Qwen3.8 Drop Nov 23
events.description: Nov 23 live API tracker records google/gemma-3-27b-it output dropping 64.4% ($0.45 to $0.16, $0.02 cached), openai/gpt-oss-120b falling 44.4% ($0.09/$0.36 to $0.05/$0.25), qwen3.6-35b-a3b -50% ($0.10/$0.90 to $0.05/$0.70), qwen3.8-27b -41.7% ($0.06/$1.96 to $0.035/$1.50), and kimi-k3.1-pro edging down (-5% to $0.2403/$8.4023), while deepseek-v4.1-flash holds $0.0498/$0.1992 ($0.001 cached) and glm-4.7 ($0.60/$2.20) & gpt-oss-20b ($0.03/$0.13) ticked up.

events.title: Gemini 4 Carbon & Argon Intro $2/$10 Pricing Expires Nov 30
events.description: Google's introductory $2.00/$10.00 rates for Gemini 4 Carbon (2M context, AA 60.0) and Argon end November 30 before doubling to $4.00/$20.00 on December 1.

events.title: Google Genie 4 Interactive World Model Launches on Gemini API
events.description: Google makes Genie 4 (models/genie-4) generally available on the Gemini v1beta Interactions API, streaming 720p 24fps worlds with 48kHz audio at $1.50/M input and $17.50/M video output (~$6.05/min).

events.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-Live-1.1 & $0.02/min WebRTC Standby Mode
events.description: OpenAI releases gpt-live-1.1 on v1/live/sessions alongside a new WebRTC standby billing mode that cuts idle voice session costs by 60% from $0.05/min to $0.02/min.

events.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 61.4 AI Index & 1M Context at $3/$15
events.description: Google debuts Gemini 4 Neon tailored for code and agentic tasks with native 1M context, 145 t/s throughput, and 95% prompt cache read discount ($0.15/1M).

events.title: OpenAI Drops GPT-6.2 Astra & Astra Pro with 1.05M Context
events.description: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.2 Astra flagship ($8/$40) and Sol ($2/$10) with reasoning mode, featuring 1.05M token windows and 95% cached input discount.

events.title: DeepSeek Eliminates Built-In Web Search & Fetch Per-Call Fees
events.description: DeepSeek drops server-side web search and fetch tool surcharges (billed solely as context tokens) while keeping V4.1-Flash prompt cache hits at $0.003-$0.006/1M.

events.title: Claude 5.5 Deep Cache Expands to 95% Read Discount
events.description: Anthropic maintains adaptive TTL caching for Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, cutting agent multi-turn conversation cost by up to 88%, while API rates hold steady post-IPO.

events.title: Groq Offers $100 Free Inference Credits on Llama 3.3 70B
events.description: Claim ultra-fast LPU inference credits. Benchmark real-time voice and agent streaming with sub-200ms TTFT.
